analysis.title: Clear Secure Inc. (YOU) Q3'26 Earnings Review: Expanding Platform Utility Supports Durable Growth and Record Capital Returns
key_insights: GS maintains Buy on Clear Secure (YOU) and raises its 12-month price target to $80 from $66. Price was $47.76, implying 67.5% upside.
Q3'26 bookings of $324m and revenue of $293m beat company guidance ($311-316m bookings, $284-287m revenue) and both GS and consensus estimates. Member acquisition and retention drove the beat.
Q4 guidance came in ahead of Street expectations. GS raises Q4'26 bookings to $338m (from $334m) and revenue to $300m (from $298m), with adj. EBITDA unchanged at $107m.
Management raised its 2026 free cash flow outlook to at least $490m, from at least $480m.

eGates are live in 53 airports, covering almost 80% of the network (GS also cites over 80% elsewhere). CLEAR Concierge is available in 42 airports. Lane experience scores are at all-time highs, supporting the 'home-to-gate' strategy.

CLEAR1 (the B2B identity segment) bookings rose nearly 3x YoY, with the largest quarter of existing partnership expansions in history, an expanded multi-year CMS contract and a new pilot with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs.

Capital returns were a record $191m in the quarter: $171m of share repurchases and about $21m of dividends. The buyback authorization was increased by about $175m, for about $254m remaining in aggregate.
Negatives GS flags: elevated product, engineering and technology investment in Q4'26 and into 1H27, and CLEAR1 bookings that management expects to fluctuate quarter to quarter on contract timing.
GS 2027 estimates: bookings $1.39bn (from $1.37bn), revenue $1.28bn (from $1.27bn), adj. EBITDA $471m (from $466m), GAAP EPS $2.39 (from $2.27).

Price target is an equal blend of EV/Sales on NTM+1 year estimates and a modified DCF. The EV/GAAP EBITDA multiple rises to 20.0x from 18.0x and the EV/FCF-SBC multiple rises to 18.0x from 15.0x, both on higher estimates.
GS scenario valuation: downside $40 (-31%), base $80, upside $120. The base case implies 6.9x EV/NTM sales and 20.0x EV/NTM GAAP EBITDA.
GS expects investor debate to center on the sustainability of member growth and pricing, the pace of CLEAR1 contribution to bookings, distribution expansion, and the durability of margin expansion.

market_movers.rationale: PT raised from $66 after a Q3'26 beat on bookings and revenue, higher Q4 guidance and a raised 2026 FCF outlook. Higher estimates support higher valuation multiples.

earnings_insights: Q3'26 (reported 11/4/2026): bookings $324m vs GS $315m and consensus $316m, guide $311-316m.
Q3'26 revenue $293m vs GS $286m and consensus $287m, guide $284-287m.
Q3'26 GAAP EPS $0.52 vs GS $0.50 and consensus $0.50. Adj. EBITDA $104m vs GS $103m and consensus $98m, adj. EBITDA margin 35.5%.
Q3'26 GAAP gross margin 68.6% vs 67.1% for both GS and consensus. CLEAR Plus members 8,474 thousand vs GS 8,364 and consensus 8,413.
GS estimate (not reported) for Q4'26: gross bookings $338m, revenue $300m, adj. EBITDA $107m, GAAP EPS $0.53.
GS estimates (not reported) for FY2026: bookings $1,249m, revenue $1,124m, adj. EBITDA $392m, GAAP EPS $1.92. FY2027: revenue $1,282m, GAAP EPS $2.39. FY2028: revenue $1,421m, GAAP EPS $2.81.
Management's 2026 FCF outlook is at least $490m, up from at least $480m.
risk_factors: Lower than expected CLEAR Plus member acquisition and retention, or longer lane times that reduce perceived value.
Lower than expected cost efficiency ramp at new airports, lengthening payback periods and pressuring margins.
Competing product offerings could hurt customer acquisition efficiency and member adoption.
A breach of CLEAR's IT systems could damage consumer trust in the platform.
Failure to meet standards set by airport partners or government stakeholders could cost CLEAR its designations and access.
A broader macro slowdown reducing travel demand could hit member additions and retention.
